data.gender_notes: Rangeet is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rang', meaning 'color'. It is often given to babies born during festive occasions, reflecting the joy and happiness of the moment. The name evokes images of vibrant colors, celebrations, and joy. The name Rangeet carries the meaning “Colorful, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rangeet usually hope their child will grow to embody colorful, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
